summary: Design occupational standards, assessment and employer-linked quality systems. Explore this practical five-day competency-based TVET course.
lede: Competency-based TVET systems training focuses on linking qualifications and assessment to workplace needs. It is for TVET authorities, workforce-development leads and employer representatives who shape standards, assessment or employer partnerships. Participants practise mapping skills demand, drafting occupational standards using DACUM job analysis, planning competency-based assessment and recognition of prior learning, and setting quality indicators and implementation actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape TVET policy, institutional delivery and employer-linked workforce development. It is relevant when your responsibilities include occupational standards, assessment systems, employer partnerships or quality assurance.
prerequisites: Relevant experience in TVET, workforce development, employer engagement, HR and learning, occupational standards, assessment or quality assurance is recommended. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as digital evidence workflows and quality-system application are addressed at operational planning level, not technical implementation level.
